sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (deductible table implies up to ₹20L; exact SI range not explicitly stated)

room_rent.note: Covered up to Standard A/C room (single occupancy AC with attached washroom, excluding suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording Section C1(b).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base policy. Optional voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. If 'Cashless Discount' optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.display: No sub-limits (optional sub-limit plan gives a premium discount)
sub_limits.note: Sub-limits (e.g. cataract Rs.40,000-55,000 per eye) apply only if the buyer opts for the sub-limit plan in return for a 15-20% discount.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required for PED. Portability credit applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr or 100% at 50%/yr.

restoration.display: Optional: reinstatement once or unlimited times a year
restoration.note: Not built in. If bought, the in-patient Sum Insured is reinstated once or unlimited times a year, for a later hospitalisation at least 2 days after discharge.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list in Annexure I; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI; must exceed 3 days. Excludes asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, vector-borne diseases, and several other conditions.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to In-patient SI. Minimum 24-hour admission required. Comfort/leisure treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses covered up to In-patient SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Reinstatement benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to In-patient SI. CB and reinstatement not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables during hospitalisation are covered as part of treatment.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma etc., no maternity, no infertility/IVF, no external congenital anomalies, no refractive error <7.5D

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sub-limits (discount), Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount
